mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "FOLLOW" ("USER_FOLLOWER", "FOLLOW_DATE", "USER_FOLLOWING") VALUES ( #{userFollower}, now(), #{userFollowing} ) ON CONFLICT ("USER_FOLLOWER", "USER_FOLLOWING") DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT u.*,ui.*,r.*,f.*,p."FEED_NO",p."USER_NO" AS "POST_USER_NO" FROM "FOLLOW" f INNER JOIN "USER" u ON u."USER_NO" = f."USER_FOLLOWING" LEFT JOIN "USER_IMG" ui USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "USER_ROLE" USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "ROLE" r USING ("ROLE_NO") LEFT JOIN "POST" p ON p."USER_NO" = u."USER_NO" WHERE u."USER_ID"=#{username}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "FOLLOW" f INNER JOIN "USER" u ON u."USER_NO" = f."USER_FOLLOWING" WHERE f."USER_FOLLOWER" = #{userNo}
AND upper(u."USER_NICKNAME") LIKE '%' || upper(#{search}) || '%'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "FOLLOW" f INNER JOIN "USER" u ON u."USER_NO" = f."USER_FOLLOWER" WHERE f."USER_FOLLOWING" = #{userNo}
AND upper(u."USER_NICKNAME") LIKE '%' || upper(#{search}) || '%'

SELECT u.*, ui."FILE_NO" AS "PROFILE_FILE_NO", ui."FILE_NAME" AS "PROFILE_FILE_NAME", ui."ORI_NAME" AS "PROFILE_ORI_NAME", r.*, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "FOLLOW" f2 WHERE f2."USER_FOLLOWER" = f."USER_FOLLOWING" AND f2."USER_FOLLOWING" = #{userNo} ) AS "MUTUAL" FROM "FOLLOW" f INNER JOIN "USER" u ON u."USER_NO" = f."USER_FOLLOWING" LEFT JOIN "USER_IMG" ui USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "USER_ROLE" USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "ROLE" r USING ("ROLE_NO") WHERE f."USER_FOLLOWER" = #{userNo} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "FOLLOW" f2 WHERE f2."USER_FOLLOWER" = f."USER_FOLLOWING" AND f2."USER_FOLLOWING" = #{userNo} ) ORDER BY u."USER_NO" LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{startNum}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "FOLLOW" f1 INNER JOIN "FOLLOW" f2 ON f1."USER_FOLLOWING" = f2."USER_FOLLOWER" AND f1."USER_FOLLOWER" = f2."USER_FOLLOWING" WHERE f1."USER_FOLLOWER" = #{currentUserNo} AND f1."USER_FOLLOWING" = #{userNo}

SELECT f1."USER_FOLLOWER" AS "userFollower", f1."USER_FOLLOWING" AS "userFollowing" FROM "FOLLOW" f1 INNER JOIN "FOLLOW" f2 ON f1."USER_FOLLOWING" = f2."USER_FOLLOWER" AND f1."USER_FOLLOWER" = f2."USER_FOLLOWING" WHERE f1."USER_FOLLOWER" = #{userFollower} AND f1."USER_FOLLOWING" = #{userFollowing}

SELECT u.*, ui."FILE_NO" AS "PROFILE_FILE_NO", ui."FILE_NAME" AS "PROFILE_FILE_NAME", ui."ORI_NAME" AS "PROFILE_ORI_NAME", r.* FROM "USER" u LEFT JOIN "USER_IMG" ui USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "USER_ROLE" USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "ROLE" r USING ("ROLE_NO") WHERE u."USER_NO" = #{userNo}
